text: The KPMG sponsorship of Spain's national rugby teams is by KPMG, S.A., a Spanish public limited company and member firm of the global KPMG organization of independent member firms affiliated with KPMG International Limited, an English private company limited by guarantee.
short: KPMG España (KPMG, S.A.) is a member firm affiliated with KPMG International Limited, an English company limited by guarantee.

source.name: KPMG España: KPMG se une a la familia de la selección española de rugby (press release; legal statement in the page footer)
source.note: The statement runs in the legal footer of KPMG España's site, on this page and others: 'Spanish public limited company and member firm of the global KPMG organization of independent member firms affiliated with KPMG International Limited, an English private company limited by guarantee.'
source.quote: sociedad anónima española y firma miembro de la organización global de KPMG de firmas miembro independientes afiliadas a KPMG International Limited, sociedad inglesa limitada por garantía
